headline: Brazilian Stock Market Crashes and Petrobras Plunges Following Lula Re-election
summary: Brazil's stock market crashed 13.88% on Monday, with Petrobras plunging 13.99% in New York trading following the re-election of President Lula.
why: Petrobras is Brazil's state-owned oil giant and a heavyweight on the B3 exchange, making its shares a key barometer for investor sentiment toward Brazilian government economic policies.

impacts.name: Petrobras
impacts.why: Brazil's market crash and political shifts directly dragged down Petrobras shares in New York trading.

why_moved: Uncertainty regarding macroeconomic and fiscal policies under the re-elected government led to a sharp sell-off in domestic equities and major state-backed stocks.
